newsitem.title: USA: DuPont to sell graphics films business to Agfa.
newsitem.headline: DuPont to sell graphics films business to Agfa.

text.p: DuPont Co. said Thursday it has signed a letter of intent to sell its graphics films and offset printing plates businesses to the Agfa-Gevaert Group, which is part of the Bayer Group.
DuPont, based in Wilmington, Del., said it expects to take an unspecified one-time charge for the sale.

The businesses to be sold employ about 2,200 people worldwide, with major production sites at Neu Isenburg, Germany, and Leeds, Margate, and Thetford in Great Britain. They had 1996 sales of $600 million.
Agfa is expected to hire most of the employees, DuPont said.
Agfa, a unit of Bayer AG, has operations in Germany and Belgium. It is seeking to supplement its core graphics systems, DuPont said.
DuPont's stock fell 75 cents to $109.25 on the New York Stock Exchange in late morning trading.
